name: voxflow
description: VoxFlow — AI voice CLI as a skill for any AI agent. Bundles 5 skills (hub, podcast, transcribe, video, slice) that drive a hosted TTS/ASR/podcast/render backend.

plugins.name: voxflow
plugins.description: AI voice CLI: text-to-speech in 200+ voices across 40+ languages, multi-speaker AI podcasts, video dubbing from SRT subtitles, transcription via cloud or local Whisper, end-to-end video translation, and short-form vertical reels via Remotion. Five bundled skills cover hub (TTS), podcast, transcribe, video, and slice (article-to-card reels).
